how_to_title: How-to Guide (Where to get the link)
how_to_title_buddy: How To Do It (Grab That Link)
how_to_google_2: Under My calendars, click Settings and sharing for your calendar.
how_to_google_3: Copy the 'Secret address in iCal format' link at the bottom and paste here.
how_to_apple_2: Click the Share (Wi-Fi icon) button next to the calendar and enable 'Public Calendar'.
how_to_apple_3: Copy the generated webcal:// link and paste here.
how_to_outlook_1: Go to outlook.live.com/calendar and open Settings > Calendar > Shared Calendars.
how_to_outlook_2: Publish a calendar, set permissions, click Publish, and use the ICS link.

ws_how_to_create: Click the '+' icon to create a new team, then set your name and role.
ws_how_to_create_buddy: Just hit '+' to build a crew, pick a name and your role man.
ws_how_to_invite: To invite your team, use the 'Copy Invite Code' button inside the workspace.
ws_how_to_invite_buddy: Grab the 'Copy Invite Code' button and spam it to your friends.
ws_how_to_assign: If you are an admin, click 'Assign New Task' to dispatch tasks to the team.
ws_how_to_assign_buddy: If you're the boss, hit 'Assign New Task' and give them something to do.
ws_task_assigned_success_buddy: Task sent out, they better do it!
